BiblicalUsage: Giloh is a place in Palestine, named 2 times in Scripture, in Joshua and 2 Samuel. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Giloh matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Giloh is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
